movies.title: Interstellar
movies.tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.
movies.description: With Earth's harvests failing, a former pilot leaves his family behind and steers a crew through a wormhole in search of a world that can still hold life. The further he travels, the more time itself becomes the thing he cannot afford.

movies.title: Inception
movies.tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.
movies.description: A thief who steals secrets from inside dreams is offered a way home: instead of taking an idea, he has to leave one behind. The job needs a dream within a dream, and his own memories keep breaking the architecture.

movies.title: The Prestige
movies.tagline: Are you watching closely?
movies.description: Two Victorian stage magicians turn a friendly rivalry into a decade-long war of sabotage over a single vanishing trick. Each is certain the other is hiding a method, and both are right.

movies.title: Arrival
movies.tagline: Why are they here?
movies.description: Twelve craft settle over the Earth and say nothing anyone can parse. A linguist is brought in to build a first vocabulary, and learning it starts to rearrange how she experiences her own life.

movies.title: The Martian
movies.tagline: Bring him home.
movies.description: Left for dead after a storm forces his crew to abort, a botanist has to farm a dead planet with what the mission happened to leave behind. Survival becomes a sequence of very stubborn engineering problems.

movies.title: Blade Runner 2049
movies.tagline: The key to the future is finally unearthed.
movies.description: A replicant detective retires his own kind for a living until a buried case suggests a birth that should have been impossible. Tracing it back means finding a man who disappeared thirty years ago.

movies.title: Dune
movies.tagline: Beyond fear, destiny awaits.
movies.description: A ducal heir is handed stewardship of the only planet that produces the empire's most valuable substance, and with it a trap generations in the making. What survives the ambush is a boy walking into the desert.

movies.title: Ex Machina
movies.tagline: There is nothing more human than the will to survive.
movies.description: A young coder wins a week at his reclusive employer's estate and finds the prize is a test: decide whether the machine upstairs is a person. She has been preparing for the interview far longer than he has.

movies.title: Gravity
movies.tagline: Don't let go.
movies.description: Debris tears through a routine spacewalk and leaves two astronauts attached to nothing at all. Getting down means crossing open orbit on whatever fuel and nerve is left.

movies.title: Annihilation
movies.tagline: Fear what's inside.
movies.description: A biologist joins the latest team sent into a stretch of coast where the laws of biology have begun rewriting themselves. Everything inside is copying everything else, including the people walking through it.

movies.title: Memento
movies.tagline: Some memories are best forgotten.
movies.description: A man who can no longer form new memories hunts his wife's killer using tattoos, photographs and notes to himself. The system works right up until someone realises he can be written to.

movies.title: Shutter Island
movies.tagline: Someone is missing.
movies.description: Two marshals sail out to a hospital for the criminally insane to find a patient who walked out of a locked room. A storm closes the harbour, and every answer the staff offers is worse than the last.

movies.title: Gone Girl
movies.tagline: You don't know what you've got 'til it's gone.
movies.description: A wife disappears on the morning of her fifth anniversary and her husband gives one bad interview too many. The case turns into a performance, and both of them know exactly who the audience is.

movies.title: Prisoners
movies.tagline: Every moment matters.
movies.description: When two girls vanish on Thanksgiving and the only suspect is released, one father decides he will get the answer himself. The detective still working the case watches the town become the thing it is afraid of.

movies.title: Zodiac
movies.tagline: There's more than one way to lose your life to a killer.
movies.description: A cartoonist, a reporter and two detectives spend years on a killer who writes letters and is never caught. The obsession outlasts the case, the marriages and most of the evidence.

movies.title: Se7en
movies.tagline: Seven deadly sins. Seven ways to die.
movies.description: A retiring detective and his replacement work a murder series staged around the deadly sins in a city where it will not stop raining. The killer is several moves ahead and intends to be found.

movies.title: The Dark Knight
movies.tagline: Welcome to a world without rules.
movies.description: Gotham's organised crime is nearly finished when a man in face paint offers the city a different kind of deal. He does not want money — he wants to prove that everyone breaks.

movies.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
movies.tagline: What a lovely day.
movies.description: A war rig turns off the road it was sent down, carrying five women away from the warlord who owned them. Everything after that is one chase across the desert and back again.

movies.title: Sicario
movies.tagline: The border is just another line to cross.
movies.description: An FBI agent volunteers for a task force whose objective nobody will state out loud. The further across the border it takes her, the clearer it becomes that she was brought along as paperwork.

movies.title: Heat
movies.tagline: A Los Angeles crime saga.
movies.description: A crew that takes scores clean and a detective who never goes home circle each other across Los Angeles. They meet once, over coffee, and agree on how it has to end.

movies.title: Whiplash
movies.tagline: The road to greatness can take you to the edge.
movies.description: A drummer at a cutthroat conservatory is taken up by a conductor who believes cruelty is the only reliable teacher. Both of them want the same thing badly enough to ruin each other for it.

movies.title: The Social Network
movies.tagline: You don't get to 500 million friends without making a few enemies.
movies.description: A Harvard sophomore builds a directory of everyone he knows and, within two years, is being deposed by the only people who liked him. The story is told by everybody suing everybody else.

movies.title: Parasite
movies.tagline: Act like you own the place.
movies.description: One family talks its way into every job in a wealthy household, one hire at a time. The arrangement holds beautifully until they find out what the last staff left in the basement.

movies.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
movies.tagline: A perfect holiday, ruined.
movies.description: A legendary concierge and his lobby boy inherit a painting, a murder charge and the attention of a very large family. The hotel keeps running while Europe comes apart outside it.

movies.title: Knives Out
movies.tagline: Everyone has a motive. No one has a clue.
movies.description: A novelist dies the night after his birthday and a detective nobody hired turns up to ask the family about it. The nurse who can't lie is the only one telling the truth.

movies.title: Jojo Rabbit
movies.tagline: An anti-hate satire.
movies.description: A boy in the Hitler Youth keeps an imaginary friend who gives terrible advice, then finds a girl hidden in his own house. Everything he has been taught has to be unlearned in a fortnight.

movies.title: La La Land
movies.tagline: Here's to the ones who dream.
movies.description: An actress between auditions and a pianist holding out for his own club fall in love in a city that rewards neither. Every choice that helps a career costs them the other one.

movies.title: Her
movies.tagline: A new operating system. An intuitive entity.
movies.description: A man who writes other people's love letters for a living falls for the voice of his operating system. She is growing far faster than the relationship can hold.

movies.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
movies.tagline: You can erase someone from your mind. Getting them out of your heart is another story.
movies.description: After a bad break-up a man pays a clinic to delete his girlfriend from his memory, then changes his mind halfway through the procedure. He spends the rest of the night hiding her in memories she doesn't belong in.

movies.title: Before Sunrise
movies.tagline: Can the greatest romance of your life last only one night?
movies.description: Two strangers get off a train in Vienna and give themselves until morning. Nothing happens except conversation, which turns out to be the whole thing.

movies.title: Manchester by the Sea
movies.tagline: Sometimes you can't go home again.
movies.description: A janitor is named guardian of his teenage nephew and has to move back to the town he left. The reason he left is the only thing anybody there still thinks about.

Drama from the director of Se7en
